description: This file contains the implementation of SQLBuilder, a utility class designed to help assemble parameterized SQL WHERE clauses safely, avoiding SQL injection risks. It provides methods to add criteria, handle logical operators, manage arguments, and generate SQL snippets with placeholders.

classes.name: SQLBuilder
classes.description: Utility class to construct SQL WHERE clauses with parameter placeholders, supporting criteria addition, logical operators, nested conditions, and argument management.

methods.name: addCriteria
methods.description: Adds a criteria with an operator and argument to the WHERE clause, ensuring criteria validity and preventing SQL injection.

methods.name: addCriteria (overload)
methods.description: Adds a criteria with an argument using AND as default logical operator.

methods.name: addNonNullCriteria
methods.description: Adds a criteria only if the provided argument is non-null, using the specified logical operator.

methods.name: addSubOperation
methods.description: Allows nesting of criteria via a Consumer<SQLBuilder>, supporting complex logical groupings.

methods.name: getSQLTemplate
methods.description: Returns the constructed SQL WHERE clause string with placeholders, starting with 'WHERE' if criteria exist.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns the list of argument objects corresponding to placeholders in the SQL snippet.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a debug string representation of the current SQLBuilder state, showing criteria and arguments.
